**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My [clever woman](../books.html#58),[^1] instead of living alone as she intended when [you](../persons.html#1160) were here, has had a flirtation with three magazines, and is at present engaged to Hogg’s [Churchman’s Family Magazine](../others.html#63) if she can agree to settlements.

[^1]: The Clever Woman of the Family.

Harris writes of CMY: “No doubt the imaginary people of her own creation were to her as real friends as any others, but to the uninitiated who received her letters this impartiality was a little confusing.

Some of her letters preserved by Miss Peard are examples, though not so typical as some others.”
